install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/sbin
cat > /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

source_host=node1
source_user=inventorysync
source_path=/etc/inventory/app.conf
destination=/etc/inventory/app.conf
identity=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519
known_hosts=/etc/inventory/node1_known_hosts
lockdir=/run/inventory-config-sync.lock

if ! mkdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "sync already running"
    exit 0
fi
tmp=
cleanup() {
    [ -z "$tmp" ] || rm -f "$tmp"
    rmdir "$lockdir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

install -d -m 0755 /etc/inventory
tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)
if ! ssh -T -i "$identity" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" "$source_user@$source_host" > "$tmp"; then
    echo "sync failed: unable to read $source_host:$source_path" >&2
    exit 1
fi

new_hash=$(sha256sum "$tmp" | awk '{print $1}')
if [ -f "$destination" ] && cmp -s "$tmp" "$destination"; then
    echo "unchanged sha256=$new_hash"
    exit 0
fi

chmod 0644 "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$destination"
tmp=
echo "updated sha256=$new_hash"
ANTRIEB_SYNC_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config
if ! crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq '/usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config'; then
  { crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\n' '*/5 * * * * /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config >> /var/log/inventory-config-sync.log 2>&1'; } | crontab -
fi
rc-update add crond default >/dev/null
rc-service crond start
/usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config
